meta.title: Enable streaming response deltas
meta.body_summary: Forward OpenAI streaming response deltas (output text and reasoning summary) to the TUI incrementally, update conversation history, and handle deltas in exec/MCP tool runner.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex closed PR without external review after iterative bugfixes; no performance evidence or reviewer engagement.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2828 changed lines across 17 files, this is a medium-to-large edit by absolute volume. It involves significant TUI widget changes (1640 lines in conversation_history_widget.rs). The PR was closed without merge, which is inconsistent with typical small-step fast-merge performance PRs; lack of review engagement and author self-close suggest the work was not ready or not aligned with project requirements.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text available in dataset; PR was closed by author without external feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Stream response text and reasoning deltas to the TUI incrementally instead of waiting for the full turn, reducing perceived latency.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author converted to draft and closed PR after a series of bug-fix commits; no reviewer activity indicates the project maintainers did not engage.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent made large changes across Rust TUI and core components but did not initiate review process; author closed the PR with no external feedback, suggesting either the feature was not ready for review or the workflow required more polish before considering merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after data; only code changes with cargo check as validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix-in-pr cycle by maintainers.

core_change_summary.description: Added streaming response delta forwarding in chat_completions, client, protocol, and codex core; updated event_processor for incremental messages; modified TUI chatwidget and conversation_history_widget to display streamed deltas; added test coverage for streaming.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commits brought in unrelated changes (e.g., stage_release.sh, README).

Merge main and multiple 'fixing bugs' commits, heavily iterating on TUI widgets.

Author converted to draft, later closed without merge.
